name: Battering RAM
impact: Breaks SGX and SEV-SNP via malicious DRAM interposer
mitigation: Physical DRAM interposition excluded from threat model; physical access controls
boundary_statement: Battering RAM (CVE-2025-20955) breaks Intel SGX and AMD SEV-SNP with a $50 malicious DRAM interposer. Requires physical access and DDR4 memory. Intel TDX is not affected (uses DDR5/TME-MK; interposer only works on DDR4). Physical-layer attack excluded from the software threat model by boundary statement.

INTENT.evidence: Paper FAQ: interposer 'only works on DDR4'; TDX uses DDR5/TME-MK and 'DDR5 reorganizes the command/address bus, which removes the possibility of adding simple switches.' TDX not affected.

AMD-SEV-SNP.evidence: Paper: breaks Intel SGX and AMD SEV-SNP via malicious DRAM interposer; re-enables BadRAM on SEV-SNP.
